name: Generate Seamless Texture Tile
description: Generates TRULY seamless, tileable textures for game terrain/materials using SDXL. Seamlessness is enforced at generation time via circular convolution padding (SeamlessTile on the model + CircularVAEDecode), so output tiles edge-to-edge with no visible seam. Runs out of the box on the base SDXL checkpoint; the LoRA is inert by default (strength 0.0) and can be enabled by passing a compatible installed SDXL style/material LoRA via lora_name with a non-zero lora_strength. Best for individual material/terrain tiles like grass, stone, brick, water, sand, etc. Generates at SDXL-native 1024x1024 by default.

prompt.description: Terrain description (e.g., 'sometile, grass terrain, top-down RPG tileset, seamless texture')

negative_prompt.description: Things to avoid (default: 'blurry, text, watermark, signature, visible seam, harsh shadows, strong directional light, vignette, perspective distortion, object, border')

lora_name.description: Optional SDXL style LoRA model name (default: dmd2_sdxl_4step_lora.safetensors, applied inertly at strength 0.0). Pass an installed SDXL style LoRA plus a non-zero lora_strength to enable it.

lora_strength.description: LoRA strength (default 0.0 = inert/no LoRA effect; raise to apply the chosen LoRA)

width.description: Tile width in pixels (default 1024 = SDXL-native; avoid 512 which produces degenerate noise on SDXL)

height.description: Tile height in pixels (default 1024 = SDXL-native; avoid 512 which produces degenerate noise on SDXL)
